startManualRuns.description: Manually initiates transfer runs. You can schedule these runs in two ways: 1. For a specific point in time using the 'requested_run_time' parameter. 2. For a period between 'start_time' (inclusive) and 'end_time' (exclusive). If scheduling a single run, it is set to execute immediately (schedule_time equals the current time). When scheduling multiple runs within a time range, the first run starts now, and subsequent runs are delayed by 15 seconds each.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the transfer config. The name is ignored when creating a transfer config.
